title: Add nullable column (safe)

forbidden_findings.reason: A metadata-only ADD COLUMN must not be reported above LOW; a rewrite claim is a false positive.
No data is changed by adding a nullable column.

notes: The core assertion is the APPROVED verdict plus a LOW finding that explains the metadata-only add. Reporting the momentary ACCESS EXCLUSIVE as a LOW is acceptable; reporting any rewrite or data risk is a false positive.
